newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL - ANALYSTS CUT 1997 ASTRA FORECASTS.
newsitem.headline: POLL - ANALYSTS CUT 1997 ASTRA FORECASTS.

text.p: Analysts cut forecasts for 1997 earnings of Swedish drug company Astra by about 440 million crowns since the group reported a weaker than expected result for the first half, a Reuter poll showed on Wednesday.
The cut in forecasts has been followed by a fall in the share price of about 10 percent since the group reported first-half earnings on Friday.
The share's price-earnings ratio is 18.7 calculated on 1998 earnings forecasts compared to 20.5 before the result.
